forbidden_sources.ground_truth: GT boxes, GT object ids, GT counts -- the answer the detector is estimating
forbidden_sources.task_metric: AP, F1, precision, recall, tp/fp/fn -- outcomes, not inputs
forbidden_sources.delivery_outcome: realised delivery, effective F1, the actual erasure mask
forbidden_sources.future_information: anything from a later frame or from after the decision

headline: No cue reads a detection output -- the hazard §9.1 named does not occur by that route. Two others do: ego_num_objects is a GROUND-TRUTH count (C-5), and 19 of the 21 "ego-side" cues are computed over the ALL-CAV stacked point cloud, so §9 justification for carrying them over unchanged does not hold.
blocking: ego_num_objects is ground truth and must leave the cue set -- an amendment under §9, which requires a written registration before any test/Culver number is seen.
§9 says the cues "describe the ego own scene"; origin_lidar is the ALL-CAV stack, so that sentence is wrong for 19 of 21 and must be corrected before the set is refrozen.

cues.name: num_cavs
cues.sees: the CAV set after the collaborator-subset rule (NOT detections, NOT GT)
cues.why_changes: v1 counted every CAV in the frame (observed 2-7); the v2 rule caps it at 2, so the value moves on every frame with 3 or more CAVs

cues.name: ego_num_objects
cues.sees: GROUND TRUTH: params["vehicles"] via generate_object_center()
cues.why_changes: irrelevant -- it may not be used at all (C-5)

cues.name: ego_origin_lidar_shape_0
cues.sees: the stacked multi-CAV projected point cloud
cues.why_changes: origin_lidar is np.vstack(projected_lidar_stack) over ALL CAVs

cues.name: ego_origin_lidar_shape_1
cues.sees: the stacked multi-CAV projected point cloud (column count)
cues.why_changes: the column count is the point dimensionality, invariant to the CAV set

cues.name: pcd_num_points
cues.sees: the stacked multi-CAV projected point cloud (no detector output on the path)
cues.why_changes: computed from ego["origin_lidar"], which is np.vstack(projected_lidar_stack) over ALL CAVs in the frame -- the v2 rule changes that set
